notes: On 6 January 2024, 30 demonstrators rallied at May Day Plaza in Minneapolis (Minnesota) to demand that the US Supreme Court continue to allow access to the abortion drug mifepristone amid the review of a ruling which could limit the drug's accessibility. Those present included members of the MN Anti-War Committee, MN Abortion Action Committee (MNAAC), Twin Cities Coalition for Justice 4 Jamar, and MN Immigrant Rights Action Committee.

On 8 January 2024, about 50 pro-Palestinian demonstrators rallied outside the State Capitol in Phoenix (Arizona) to denounce a pro-Israel resolution that the legislature had just passed and to demand support for Palestinian 'freedom', a permanent ceasefire in Gaza, and an end to U.S. support for Israel's 'genocide' amid the Israel-Hamas war which began in October 2023. The demonstration was organized by the Palestinian American Community Center and joined by the Navajo Nation, O'odham indigenous supporters, JVP, Socialist Revolution, Arizona Palestine Solidarity Alliance, Arizona Muslim Alliance, CAIR, Common Defense, Arizona Palestine Network, and SJP.
On 9 January 2024, workers with UAW Local 1391 rallied in East Dubuque (Illinois) as part of an ongoing labor strike to demand increased pay and an improved contract.

On 11 January 2024, dozens of demonstrators, including Christian faith leaders and educational leaders, gathered outside Chimneyrock Elementary in Memphis (Tennessee) to demonstrate against an After School Satan Club.

On 11 January 2024, protesters rallied in Northampton (Massachusetts) to demand the closure of Guantanamo Bay detention camp due to poor living conditions, as well as what they claimed is 'torture methods and abuse.' No More Guantanamos, Witness Against Torture, CodePink, and Amherst Amnesty International Group 128 organized the rally.

On 12 January 2024, members of the LGBTQ+ community and Fairness West Virginia gathered at the State Capitol in Charleston (West Virginia) to support a bill which would prohibit job, housing, and public accommodation discrimination for LBGTQ+ people.

On 17 January 2024, about 25 people, including members of Emancipate NC and victim's family members, gathered in Raleigh (North Carolina) to demand justice for an African American man who died after being tasered by police last year and accountability from the police department.

On 18 January 2024, almost 20 people dressed in bridal gowns held a demonstration in the state Capitol in Olympia (Washington) to support efforts to ban child marriages in the state. Unchained At Last, Zonta International and the AHA Foundation were present.

Around 18 January 2024 (as reported), White Lives Matter affiliates gathered in Alabama (coded as Montgomery (Alabama)) to demonstrate in favor of White Lives Matter, hold antisemitic signs, and promote the group.

source: 5 On Your Side; KMOV4; KWMU; St. Louis Post-Dispatch
notes: On 18 January 2024, hundreds of students walked out of class to hold a rally at Francis Howell High School and Francis Howell North High School in Saint Charles (Missouri) to protest against the Francis Howell School Board's decision to remove Black History and Black Literature courses due to the courses' connection to the 'Social Justice Standards: The Teaching Tolerance Anti-Bias Framework.'
